--[[
	WARNING: Heads up! This script has not been verified by ScriptBlox. Use at your own risk!
]]
-- ==========================================
-- MENÚ DE CARGA "ROJANSEL" + IDIOMA
-- ==========================================
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local DISCORD_INVITE = "https://discord.gg/uY8waH3b8"

-- Variable Global para almacenar el idioma seleccionado ('es' o 'en')
local SELECTED_LANGUAGE = "es"

-- Diccionario de Textos / Localized Texts
local Translations = {
    es = {
        title = "Anime Slap [TODOS LOS ITEMS]",
        getAll = "Obtener TODO (Gratis + Gamepass)",
        returnSpawn = "Volver a Mi Posición Inicial",
        joinDiscord = "Unirme a Discord",
        linkCopied = "¡Enlace Copiado!",
        itemsObtained = "¡%d Objetos Obtenidos!",
        discordNotice = "Únete a Discord: puedes encontrar más scripts mejores\n" .. DISCORD_INVITE,
        loading = "Cargando..."
    },
    en = {
        title = "Anime Slap [ALL ITEMS]",
        getAll = "Get ALL (Free + Gamepass)",
        returnSpawn = "Return to Spawn",
        joinDiscord = "Join Discord",
        linkCopied = "Link Copied!",
        itemsObtained = "Obtained %d Items!",
        discordNotice = "Join Discord: you can find better scripts here\n" .. DISCORD_INVITE,
        loading = "Loading..."
    }
}

-- 1. OBTENER INTERFAZ SEGURA (CoreGui o PlayerGui)
local ParentGui
local success, coreGui = pcall(function() return game:GetService("CoreGui") end)
if gethui then
    ParentGui = gethui()
elseif success and coreGui and coreGui:FindFirstChild("RobloxGui") then
    ParentGui = coreGui:FindFirstChild("RobloxGui")
else
    ParentGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

-- Limpiar interfaz anterior si existe
if ParentGui:FindFirstChild("Rojansel_LoadingScreen") then
    ParentGui["Rojansel_LoadingScreen"]:Destroy()
end

-- Crear ScreenGui principal para la carga
local LoadingScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
LoadingScreenGui.Name = "Rojansel_LoadingScreen"
LoadingScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
LoadingScreenGui.DisplayOrder = 99999
LoadingScreenGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
LoadingScreenGui.Parent = ParentGui

-- Marco de fondo principal
local IntroFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
IntroFrame.Name = "IntroFrame"
IntroFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
IntroFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 12)
IntroFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0
IntroFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
IntroFrame.Parent = LoadingScreenGui

-- Contenedor Central
local CenterContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
CenterContainer.Name = "CenterContainer"
CenterContainer.Size = UDim2.new(0, 420, 0, 240)
CenterContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -210, 0.5, -120)
CenterContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
CenterContainer.Parent = IntroFrame

-- Texto de la marca "ROJANSEL"
local IntroText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
IntroText.Name = "IntroText"
IntroText.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 60)
IntroText.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
IntroText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
IntroText.Text = "ROJANSEL"
IntroText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 30, 30)
IntroText.TextSize = 42
IntroText.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
IntroText.TextTransparency = 1
IntroText.Parent = CenterContainer

-- Borde brillante
local UIStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
UIStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
UIStroke.Thickness = 3
UIStroke.Transparency = 1
UIStroke.Parent = IntroText

-- Fondo de la Barra de Carga
local ProgressBarBackground = Instance.new("Frame")
ProgressBarBackground.Name = "ProgressBarBackground"
ProgressBarBackground.Size = UDim2.new(0, 320, 0, 12)
ProgressBarBackground.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -160, 0, 75)
ProgressBarBackground.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 35)
ProgressBarBackground.BorderSizePixel = 0
ProgressBarBackground.BackgroundTransparency = 1
ProgressBarBackground.Parent = CenterContainer

local bgCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
bgCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
bgCorner.Parent = ProgressBarBackground

-- Relleno de la Barra de Carga
local ProgressBarFill = Instance.new("Frame")
ProgressBarFill.Name = "ProgressBarFill"
ProgressBarFill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
ProgressBarFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 40, 40)
ProgressBarFill.BorderSizePixel = 0
ProgressBarFill.BackgroundTransparency = 1
ProgressBarFill.Parent = ProgressBarBackground

local fillCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
fillCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
fillCorner.Parent = ProgressBarFill

-- Texto de Porcentaje
local LoadingStatus = Instance.new("TextLabel")
LoadingStatus.Name = "LoadingStatus"
LoadingStatus.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
LoadingStatus.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 92)
LoadingStatus.BackgroundTransparency = 1
LoadingStatus.Text = "Cargando... / Loading... 0%"
LoadingStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
LoadingStatus.TextSize = 14
LoadingStatus.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
LoadingStatus.TextTransparency = 1
LoadingStatus.Parent = CenterContainer

-- Aviso de Discord
local DiscordNotice = Instance.new("TextLabel")
DiscordNotice.Name = "DiscordNotice"
DiscordNotice.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 45)
DiscordNotice.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 120)
DiscordNotice.BackgroundTransparency = 1
DiscordNotice.Text = "Discord: " .. DISCORD_INVITE
DiscordNotice.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(114, 137, 218)
DiscordNotice.TextSize = 13
DiscordNotice.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
DiscordNotice.TextTransparency = 1
DiscordNotice.Parent = CenterContainer

-- CONTENEDOR DE SELECCIÓN DE IDIOMA
local LanguageFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
LanguageFrame.Name = "LanguageFrame"
LanguageFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 80)
LanguageFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 150)
LanguageFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
LanguageFrame.Visible = false
LanguageFrame.Parent = CenterContainer

local LangLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
LangLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 25)
LangLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
LangLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
LangLabel.Text = "Selecciona tu idioma / Select your language:"
LangLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
LangLabel.TextSize = 15
LangLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
LangLabel.TextTransparency = 1
LangLabel.Parent = LanguageFrame

local BtnSpanish = Instance.new("TextButton")
BtnSpanish.Size = UDim2.new(0, 140, 0, 35)
BtnSpanish.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -150, 0, 35)
BtnSpanish.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 30, 30)
BtnSpanish.Text = "Español 🇪🇸"
BtnSpanish.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
BtnSpanish.TextSize = 14
BtnSpanish.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
BtnSpanish.BackgroundTransparency = 1
BtnSpanish.TextTransparency = 1
BtnSpanish.Parent = LanguageFrame

local cornerES = Instance.new("UICorner")
cornerES.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
cornerES.Parent = BtnSpanish

local BtnEnglish = Instance.new("TextButton")
BtnEnglish.Size = UDim2.new(0, 140, 0, 35)
BtnEnglish.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 10, 0, 35)
BtnEnglish.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 120, 215)
BtnEnglish.Text = "English 🇺🇸"
BtnEnglish.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
BtnEnglish.TextSize = 14
BtnEnglish.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
BtnEnglish.BackgroundTransparency = 1
BtnEnglish.TextTransparency = 1
BtnEnglish.Parent = LanguageFrame

local cornerEN = Instance.new("UICorner")
cornerEN.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
cornerEN.Parent = BtnEnglish

-- Copiar portapapeles al iniciar
if setclipboard then
    pcall(function() setclipboard(DISCORD_INVITE) end)
elseif toclipboard then
    pcall(function() toclipboard(DISCORD_INVITE) end)
end

-- Declarar variables para la UI Principal (definida más abajo)
local Title, GetToolsBtn, ReturnSpawnBtn, DiscordBtn

-- Función para actualizar textos según el idioma elegido
local function ApplyLanguage(lang)
    SELECTED_LANGUAGE = lang
    local t = Translations[lang]
    if Title then Title.Text = t.title end
    if GetToolsBtn then GetToolsBtn.Text = t.getAll end
    if ReturnSpawnBtn then ReturnSpawnBtn.Text = t.returnSpawn end
    if DiscordBtn then DiscordBtn.Text = t.joinDiscord end
    if DiscordNotice then DiscordNotice.Text = t.discordNotice end
end

-- Lógica de Animación y Selección
task.spawn(function()
    task.wait(0.3)
    
    local fadeInInfo = TweenInfo.new(1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
    TweenService:Create(IntroText, fadeInInfo, {TextTransparency = 0}):Play()
    TweenService:Create(UIStroke, fadeInInfo, {Transparency = 0.2}):Play()
    TweenService:Create(ProgressBarBackground, fadeInInfo, {BackgroundTransparency = 0}):Play()
    TweenService:Create(ProgressBarFill, fadeInInfo, {BackgroundTransparency = 0}):Play()
    TweenService:Create(LoadingStatus, fadeInInfo, {TextTransparency = 0}):Play()
    TweenService:Create(DiscordNotice, fadeInInfo, {TextTransparency = 0}):Play()
    
    task.wait(0.5)

    -- Barra de Carga (10 Segundos)
    local loadingTime = 10
    local barTweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(loadingTime, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)
    TweenService:Create(ProgressBarFill, barTweenInfo, {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)}):Play()
    
    local startTime = tick()
    while tick() - startTime < loadingTime do
        local progress = math.clamp((tick() - startTime) / loadingTime, 0, 1)
        LoadingStatus.Text = "Cargando... " .. math.floor(progress * 100) .. "%"
        task.wait(0.05)
    end
    LoadingStatus.Text = "100%"
    
    task.wait(0.3)

    -- Ocultar barra y mostrar menú de Selección de Idioma con Animación
    local fadeOutQuick = TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
    TweenService:Create(ProgressBarBackground, fadeOutQuick, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
    TweenService:Create(ProgressBarFill, fadeOutQuick, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
    TweenService:Create(LoadingStatus, fadeOutQuick, {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()

    task.wait(0.4)
    LanguageFrame.Visible = true

    -- Animación FadeIn de Opciones de Idioma
    TweenService:Create(LangLabel, fadeInInfo, {TextTransparency = 0}):Play()
    TweenService:Create(BtnSpanish, fadeInInfo, {BackgroundTransparency = 0, TextTransparency = 0}):Play()
    TweenService:Create(BtnEnglish, fadeInInfo, {BackgroundTransparency = 0, TextTransparency = 0}):Play()

    -- Esperar la selección del usuario
    local langSelected = false
    local function SelectLang(lang)
        if langSelected then return end
        langSelected = true
        ApplyLanguage(lang)

        -- Animación de salida al seleccionar idioma
        local fadeOutInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.8, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)
        TweenService:Create(IntroText, fadeOutInfo, {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
        TweenService:Create(UIStroke, fadeOutInfo, {Transparency = 1}):Play()
        TweenService:Create(DiscordNotice, fadeOutInfo, {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
        TweenService:Create(LangLabel, fadeOutInfo, {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
        TweenService:Create(BtnSpanish, fadeOutInfo, {BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
        TweenService:Create(BtnEnglish, fadeOutInfo, {BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
        
        local frameFadeOut = TweenService:Create(IntroFrame, fadeOutInfo, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
        frameFadeOut:Play()
        frameFadeOut.Completed:Wait()
        
        LoadingScreenGui:Destroy()
    end

    BtnSpanish.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() SelectLang("es") end)
    BtnEnglish.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() SelectLang("en") end)
end)

-- ==========================================
-- SCRIPT ANIME SLAP TOWER + BOTÓN DISCORD
-- ==========================================
local spawnCFrame = nil
if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
	spawnCFrame = LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
end

LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
	task.wait(1)
	if char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
		spawnCFrame = char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
	end
end)

if ParentGui:FindFirstChild("AnimeSlapRemote_Gui") then
	ParentGui["AnimeSlapRemote_Gui"]:Destroy()
end

local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "AnimeSlapRemote_Gui"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
ScreenGui.Parent = ParentGui

-- MARCO PRINCIPAL (MENÚ)
local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
MainFrame.Name = "MainFrame"
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 230, 0, 200)
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -115, 0.35, 0)
MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 25)
MainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 2
MainFrame.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)
MainFrame.Active = true
MainFrame.Draggable = true
MainFrame.Visible = true
MainFrame.Parent = ScreenGui

Title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 30)
Title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 0)
Title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Title.Text = Translations.es.title
Title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
Title.TextSize = 13
Title.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
Title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
Title.Parent = MainFrame

GetToolsBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
GetToolsBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 40)
GetToolsBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 35)
GetToolsBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 120, 215)
GetToolsBtn.Text = Translations.es.getAll
GetToolsBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
GetToolsBtn.TextSize = 11
GetToolsBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
GetToolsBtn.Parent = MainFrame

ReturnSpawnBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
ReturnSpawnBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 35)
ReturnSpawnBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 85)
ReturnSpawnBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 45)
ReturnSpawnBtn.Text = Translations.es.returnSpawn
ReturnSpawnBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
ReturnSpawnBtn.TextSize = 12
ReturnSpawnBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
ReturnSpawnBtn.Parent = MainFrame

-- Botón para unirse a Discord dentro del menú
DiscordBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
DiscordBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 35)
DiscordBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 130)
DiscordBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(88, 101, 242)
DiscordBtn.Text = Translations.es.joinDiscord
DiscordBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
DiscordBtn.TextSize = 12
DiscordBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
DiscordBtn.Parent = MainFrame

DiscordBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if setclipboard then
        setclipboard(DISCORD_INVITE)
    elseif toclipboard then
        toclipboard(DISCORD_INVITE)
    end
    DiscordBtn.Text = Translations[SELECTED_LANGUAGE].linkCopied
    task.wait(1.5)
    DiscordBtn.Text = Translations[SELECTED_LANGUAGE].joinDiscord
end)

-- BOTÓN FLOTANTE (EMOJI PARA ABRIR / CERRAR)
local ToggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
ToggleBtn.Name = "ToggleButton"
ToggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 45, 0, 45)
ToggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.4, 0)
ToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 30)
ToggleBtn.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)
ToggleBtn.BorderSizePixel = 2
ToggleBtn.Text = "⚡"
ToggleBtn.TextSize = 22
ToggleBtn.Active = true
ToggleBtn.Draggable = true
ToggleBtn.Parent = ScreenGui

local UiCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
UiCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
UiCorner.Parent = ToggleBtn

ToggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	MainFrame.Visible = not MainFrame.Visible
end)

-- Configuración de Herramientas y Remotos
local function SetupToolWithRemotes(tool)
	if not tool or not tool:IsA("Tool") then return end

	for _, part in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			part.CanCollide = false
			part.Massless = true
		end
	end

	for _, scriptItem in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
		if scriptItem:IsA("LocalScript") then
			scriptItem.Disabled = false
		end
	end

	tool.Activated:Connect(function()
		local char = LocalPlayer.Character
		if not char then return end

		for _, child in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
			if child:IsA("Animation") then
				local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if humanoid then
					local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or humanoid
					local track = animator:LoadAnimation(child)
					track:Play()
				end
			elseif child:IsA("Sound") then
				child:Play()
			end
		end

		for _, item in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
			if item:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
				pcall(function() item:FireServer() end)
			end
		end
		
		for _, remote in ipairs(ReplicatedStorage:GetDescendants()) do
			if remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") and (remote.Name:lower():find("slap") or remote.Name:lower():find("use") or remote.Name:lower():find("ability") or remote.Name:lower():find("pass") or remote.Name:lower():find("buy")) then
				pcall(function() remote:FireServer(tool.Name) end)
			end
		end
	end)
end

-- Escaneo de Objetos y Gamepasses
GetToolsBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local containers = {Workspace, ReplicatedStorage, Lighting, ServerStorage}
	local total = 0

	for _, container in ipairs(containers) do
		pcall(function()
			for _, item in ipairs(container:GetDescendants()) do
				if item:IsA("Tool") then
					if not LocalPlayer.Backpack:FindFirstChild(item.Name) and (LocalPlayer.Character and not LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild(item.Name)) then
						local clone = item:Clone()
						SetupToolWithRemotes(clone)
						clone.Parent = LocalPlayer.Backpack
						total = total + 1
					end
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	GetToolsBtn.Text = string.format(Translations[SELECTED_LANGUAGE].itemsObtained, total)
	task.wait(1.5)
	GetToolsBtn.Text = Translations[SELECTED_LANGUAGE].getAll
end)

-- Retorno al Spawn
ReturnSpawnBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local char = LocalPlayer.Character
	if char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and spawnCFrame then
		char.HumanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
		char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = spawnCFrame
	end
end)

🌎 Universal Item Unlocker | All Games

🔥 A universal script designed for multiple Roblox games! Simply press the button to automatically unlock or obtain available items in supported games.

✨ Features:

- 🌎 Universal script for multiple games
- 🎁 Automatically obtains available items with one button
- ⚡ Simple, fast, and easy to use
- 🎮 Works differently depending on the game
- 🔓 Some games may provide all items, while others only provide certain items
- ⚠️ Not all obtained items will work correctly in every game

Note: Compatibility and functionality depend on each game's systems. Some items may appear but not function properly, and some games may not support all items.

Enjoy exploring different games with one simple script!
